summary: Retested only the 3 issues from iteration_139, at 390x844 as pro (test_session_pro_1). All 3 are FIXED. (1) updateCatch race: typed a note, then clicked fish-queue-remove straight away. The item was removed. Did the same with a weight on a second item. After a reload, IndexedDB held only the 1 untouched item, so neither removed photo came back. (2) Weight validation: 1600 kg on blur showed the toast "That's over 1,500 kg. Check the weight.", cleared the input, and saved weight_kg as null in IDB. 422 branch: route-intercepted POST /api/ai/fish to return 422 for the first item and 200 not_fish for the second. Both calls were made. Toasts: 'check its note and weight, then try again. It's still waiting.' and 'TEST_not a fish'. The queue ended with 1 item (the 422 one kept, the not_fish one dropped), so the loop carried on. (3) Bulk Quick Reg: with 4 lines (2 valid, 1 with no email, 1 with the bad email 'bad@x') the button showed 'Quick Reg 2'. The save added 2, and bulk-quick-skipped listed both 'No email found' lines. The button was then disabled, and a forced second click sent no second POST (1 POST in total). Editing the text re-enabled it and cleared the skipped box.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: 'bad@x' lines are shown as 'No email found'. An 'invalid email' wording would be clearer.
The 3,300 lb limit check is untested here (the imperial path wasn't exercised). The code converts lb to kg before the 1500 check, so it should behave the same.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 crew_register rows (test_a_qr139/test_b_qr139@example.com, owner_id test-user-pro) and deleted them by email. The register for pro is empty again. The IndexedDB mbp_fish_queue was deleted after the tests. AI was mocked via route intercept, so no Magic was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fish dialog covers network-status. To go online: Escape, then the 'Discard changes' button, then network-status, then sync-confirm-ok-btn, then reopen via app-menu-btn and app-menu-fish-item. Crew dialog: window.dispatchEvent(new Event('mbp:open-crew')), then crew-register-open-btn, then reg-bulk-quick-btn. The crew_register field is owner_id (not user_id).
